patterns.name: unexpected_bulk_data_transfer
patterns.evidence: High-volume outbound transfer to an unfamiliar destination with many files, or confirmed copy of whole vault to an external address.
patterns.condition: T1041/T1048 tag, confirmed high-volume outbound transfer to a new external IP plus many files, or evidence of an entire vault copied externally.
patterns.rationale: High-volume outbound transfer to an unfamiliar destination with many files, or confirmed copy of whole vault to an external address.

patterns.name: correlated_repeated_large_transfer
patterns.evidence: Large outbound volume and verified repeated transfers, or repetition outside usual hours.
patterns.condition: T1041/T1048 tag, large verified outbound volume and per-alert correlated repeat count, with unusual hours or clear repeated bulk transfers.
patterns.rationale: Large outbound volume and verified repeated transfers, or repetition outside usual hours.

patterns.name: unusual_outbound_transfer_channel
patterns.evidence: Large transfers using an unusual port and repeated many-file activity, or command channel transfer with novel destination and repeated count.
patterns.condition: T1041/T1048 tag, unusual outbound port with many repeated file transfers, or command channel and new destination with confirmed repeat count.
patterns.rationale: Large transfers using an unusual port and repeated many-file activity, or command channel transfer with novel destination and repeated count.

patterns.name: suspicious_archive_outbound_transfer
patterns.evidence: Large archive/bundled-data transfer to a novel destination with further corroboration from out-of-hours, repeated, or multi-destination activity.
patterns.condition: T1048 tag, large archive transfer to unfamiliar external IP, corroborated by off-hours timing, repetition or multiple destinations.
patterns.rationale: Large archive/bundled-data transfer to a novel destination with further corroboration from out-of-hours, repeated, or multi-destination activity.

patterns.name: exfiltration_context_needs_review
patterns.evidence: Incomplete, isolated or lower-severity outbound activity; do not enforce a block.
patterns.condition: T1041/T1048 tag with an isolated or incomplete outbound signal; do not block without confirmed volume and abnormal context.
patterns.rationale: Incomplete, isolated or lower-severity outbound activity; do not enforce a block.

guardrails: Do not block on bytes, MITRE tags, severe rule level or suspicious wording alone.
Require a source IP, destination IP, identified account, validated high outbound bytes and independent anomaly evidence.
Missing destination, incomplete transfer, failed transfer or normal approved backup must not block.
A Wazuh rule.firedtimes counter is not a correlated transfer count; use explicit per-alert data.count.
No networking, file access, secret values, active traffic interception or live blocking.
